Name: Commercial ANZ Landscape
Documentation:
Application cooperation view for the ANZ commercial domain.
Commercial ANZ is the central collaboration boundary.
The internal estate is grouped into Customer Service, Sales, SPT, Marketing, and Finance.
Microsoft Dynamics spans Customer Service, Sales, and SPT.
Informatica PIM ANZ is shown on the left as an upstream integration into Magento ANZ, while QAD EE 2019 is shown on the right as a downstream ERP integration from Microsoft Dynamics.

Name: Data and Analytics Landscape
Documentation:
Application cooperation view for the Data and Analytics domain.
The central collaboration contains the major platform and service components grouped into
Data Ingestion, Data Warehousing, Analytics, Automation, and DevOps.
Source applications integrate inbound from the left, while Medlink is shown as a downstream consumer on the right.

Name: ERP ANZ Landscape
Documentation:
Application cooperation view for the ANZ ERP realm.
ERP ANZ is the central collaboration/core.
QAD EE 2019 and Pro2SQL ANZ are contained within that core.
External systems sit around the core and connect only through explicit outbound flows.

Name: PSS 2.0 Azure Reference Architecture
Documentation:
Azure-native target architecture for PSS 2.0.
This diagram is intended as the first reusable modernization template for application upgrades in an Azure-first environment.
It contrasts the legacy server-hosted pattern with the target Azure runtime pattern and makes the supporting platform services explicit.
